sentences.zh: 志一百八

translations.literal: Treatise 108
translations.idiomatic: Treatise 108

sentences.zh: 兵四

translations.literal: Military 4
translations.idiomatic: Military 4

sentences.zh: 鄉兵

translations.literal: Local Militia
translations.idiomatic: Local Militia

sentences.zh: 鄉兵始自雍、乾，旋募旋散，初非經制之師。

translations.literal: Local militia began in the Yongzheng and Qianlong reigns; they were recruited and disbanded in turn, and from the outset were not troops of the regular establishment.
translations.idiomatic: Local militia dated back to the Yongzheng and Qianlong reigns, raised and released in cycles rather than maintained as part of the standing army.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶間，平川、楚教匪，鄉兵之功始著。

translations.literal: During the Jiaqing period, in pacifying the Sichuan and Hubei sect rebels, the achievements of local militia first became prominent.
translations.idiomatic: It was during the Jiaqing era, in the campaign to suppress the Sichuan and Hubei sect rebels, that local militia first won clear renown.

sentences.zh: 道光之季，粵西寇起，各省舉辦團練，有駐守地方者，有隨營征剿者。

translations.literal: At the end of the Daoguang reign, rebels rose in western Guangdong; each province raised militia companies—some garrisoned local areas, others marched with regular camps in pursuit and suppression.
translations.idiomatic: Near the close of the Daoguang reign, rebellion broke out in western Guangdong, and provinces across the empire organized militia companies—some to hold their own districts, others to campaign alongside regular forces.

sentences.zh: 侍郎曾國籓以衡、湘團練討寇，練鄉兵為勇營，以兵制部勒之，卒平巨憝，其始皆鄉兵也。

translations.literal: Vice Minister Zeng Guofan used the Hunan and Hengyang militia to suppress rebels, trained local militia into brave battalions, and organized them according to military regulations; ultimately he pacified the great scourge—all of whom had originally been local militia.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister Zeng Guofan mobilized the Hunan and Hengyang militia against the rebels, drilled local militiamen into formal brave battalions under regular military discipline, and in the end crushed the great menace—yet every man in those ranks had begun as a village fighter.

sentences.zh: 而邊徼之地，剿有鄉兵。

translations.literal: In the frontier regions, there were also local militia for suppression operations.
translations.idiomatic: On the frontiers, too, local militia were raised for pacification duty.

sentences.zh: 其在東三省者，則寧古塔以東之赫哲部、克雅克部，混同江東北之鄂倫春部，不設佐領，惟設鄉兵姓長。

translations.literal: In the Three Eastern Provinces: the Hezhe and Keyake tribes east of Ningguta and the Oroqen tribe northeast of the Songhua River had no banner assistants appointed; only clan chiefs for local militia were established.
translations.idiomatic: In the Three Eastern Provinces, the Hezhe and Keyake peoples east of Ningguta and the Oroqen northeast of the Songhua River had no banner assistants; only clan chiefs of local militia were appointed.

sentences.zh: 其在黑龍江者，有打牲人，在江以南之錫伯、卦勒察，江以北之索倫、達瑚爾，則附屬於滿營。

translations.literal: In Heilongjiang there were hunters-for-tribute; the Xibe and Guilecha south of the river and the Solon and Dahur north of the river were attached to Manchu garrisons.
translations.idiomatic: In Heilongjiang there were tribute hunters; the Xibe and Guilecha south of the river and the Solon and Dahur north of it were attached to Manchu garrisons.

sentences.zh: 在蒙古者，蒙兵而外，有奇古民勇。

translations.literal: In Mongolia, besides Mongol troops, there were Qigu civilian braves.
translations.idiomatic: In Mongolia, beyond the regular Mongol forces, there were Qigu civilian braves.

sentences.zh: 在山、陝邊外者，有番兵，有僧俗兵。

translations.literal: Beyond the Shanxi and Shaanxi borders there were frontier tribesmen troops and both monastic and lay troops.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond the Shanxi and Shaanxi frontiers there were frontier tribesmen, monastic troops, and lay troops.

sentences.zh: 在四川、雲南、貴州邊境者，有夷兵，有土司兵，有黑裸勇丁。

translations.literal: On the borders of Sichuan, Yunnan, and Guizhou there were Yi troops, native chieftain troops, and Heiluo brave militiamen.
translations.idiomatic: Along the Sichuan, Yunnan, and Guizhou borderlands there were Yi fighters, native chieftain levies, and Heiluo brave militiamen.

sentences.zh: 在西藏者，有藏番兵。

translations.literal: In Tibet there were Tibetan frontier troops.
translations.idiomatic: In Tibet there were Tibetan frontier troops.

sentences.zh: 皆與內地鄉兵不同，故不詳。

translations.literal: All of these differed from inland local militia, and so are not described in detail.
translations.idiomatic: All of these differed from the local militia of the interior provinces, and so are not treated here in detail.

sentences.zh: 其各直省之鄉兵，曰屯練，曰民壯，曰鄉團，曰獵戶，曰漁團，曰沙民。

translations.literal: The local militia of the various provinces were known as garrison militia, civilian strongmen, village militia companies, hunter troops, fishing militia, and sand-dwellers.
translations.idiomatic: In the provinces themselves, local militia went by many names: garrison militia, civilian strongmen, village companies, hunter bands, fishing militia, and sand-dwellers.

sentences.zh: 額數之多寡不齊，器械之良窳不一，餉章之增減不定，良以聚散無恆，故與額兵迥異，無編製之可紀。

translations.literal: Their authorized numbers varied widely, weapons ranged from excellent to poor, and pay scales fluctuated—the reason being that their assembly and dispersal lacked consistency; thus they differed greatly from regular troops and there was no fixed organization to record.
translations.idiomatic: Authorized strength varied, weapons ranged from good to poor, and pay schedules shifted constantly, for these forces gathered and dispersed without fixed routine; they bore little resemblance to regular troops, and no stable table of organization could be recorded.

sentences.zh: 茲特志其始末於後焉。

translations.literal: Here the full history from beginning to end is recorded below.
translations.idiomatic: What follows is a record of their origins and development.

sentences.zh: 雍正八年，鄂爾泰平西南夷烏蒙之亂，調官兵萬餘人，鄉兵半之，遂定東川，是為鄉兵之始。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Yongzheng, Ortai suppressed the Wumeng rebellion among the southwestern Yi peoples, mobilizing over ten thousand regular troops with local militia numbering half that, thereby securing Dongchuan—this marked the beginning of local militia.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Yongzheng, Ortai put down the Wumeng rebellion in the southwestern Yi country, calling up more than ten thousand regular troops and an equal number of local militia, and thus secured Dongchuan—this is taken as the beginning of local militia service.

sentences.zh: 乾隆三十八年，用兵小金川，定邊將軍溫福、定西將軍阿桂疏言，調滿洲兵道遠費重，不如多用鄉兵，人地相宜。

translations.literal: In the thirty-eighth year of Qianlong, during the Xiaojin River campaign, Generals Wen Fu and Agui memorialized that deploying Manchu troops from afar was costly and that it would be better to use more local militia, who were suited to the people and terrain.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-eighth year of Qianlong, during operations in the Lesser Jin River region, Generals Wen Fu and Agui argued in memorial that hauling Manchu troops from afar was ruinously expensive and that local militia, matched to people and terrain, should be used instead.

sentences.zh: 四川鄉兵，以金川屯練為強，自平定金川以後，設屯練鄉兵，其糧餉倍於額兵，分屯大小金川兩路，春夏訓練，秋冬蒐獵，有戰事則搜剿山路，退兵則為殿後之用。

translations.literal: Sichuan local militia, with Jinchuan garrison militia as the strongest, were established after the pacification of Jinchuan; their rations were double those of regular troops. They were garrisoned along both the Greater and Lesser Jinchuan routes, trained in spring and summer and hunted in autumn and winter; in wartime they searched and suppressed along mountain paths, and on retreat served as the rearguard.
translations.idiomatic: Among Sichuan's local militia, the Jinchuan garrison companies were the strongest. After Jinchuan was pacified, garrison militia were established with rations twice those of regular troops, posted along both the Greater and Lesser Jinchuan routes. They drilled in spring and summer, hunted in autumn and winter, scoured mountain trails when fighting broke out, and covered the army's withdrawal when it pulled back.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶初，苗疆事起，傅鼐以鄉兵平苗，功冠諸將。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Jiaqing, when trouble arose in the Miao frontier, Fu Nai pacified the Miao with local militia, his achievements surpassing all other generals.
translations.idiomatic: At the opening of the Jiaqing reign, when unrest erupted in the Miao frontier, Fu Nai suppressed the Miao with local militia and outshone every other commander.

sentences.zh: 詔以鼐總理邊務，令各省督撫以鼐練鄉兵之法練官兵。

translations.literal: An edict appointed Fu to oversee frontier affairs and ordered provincial governors to train regular troops according to Fu's method of training local militia.
translations.idiomatic: The throne then put Fu in charge of frontier affairs and instructed every provincial governor to drill regular troops by the same methods Fu had used to train local militia.

sentences.zh: 川、楚教匪之役，官兵征討，而鄉兵之功為多。

translations.literal: In the campaign against the Sichuan and Hubei sect rebels, regular troops conducted the suppression, but local militia accounted for the greater share of achievement.
translations.idiomatic: In the war against the Sichuan and Hubei sect rebels, regular troops bore the main burden of campaigning, yet local militia won the greater share of credit.

sentences.zh: 其勛績最著者，文臣則四川按察使劉清，武臣則四川提督桂涵，湖北提督羅思舉，各統鄉兵，分路剿寇，大小數百戰，遂奏膚功。

translations.literal: Those whose achievements were most outstanding were, among civil officials, Liu Qing, Sichuan Surveillance Commissioner, and among military officials, Gui Han, Sichuan Provincial Commander, and Luo Siju, Hubei Provincial Commander; each commanded local militia, suppressed rebels along separate routes in several hundred battles large and small, and thus achieved complete victory.
translations.idiomatic: The most celebrated leaders were the civil official Liu Qing, Sichuan Surveillance Commissioner, and the military commanders Gui Han of Sichuan and Luo Siju of Hubei. Each led local militia along separate routes, fought several hundred engagements large and small, and in the end won a thorough victory.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶十七年，以雲南邊外野夷裸匪肆擾，而緬寧、騰越各隘皆瘴癘之地，難駐官兵，乃練鄉兵一千六百人，以八百人駐守緬寧之丙野山樑等處，以八百人駐守騰越蠻章山等處，省官兵徵調之勞。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year of Jiaqing, because wild Yi and Luo bandits beyond Yunnan's borders raided wantonly and the passes at Mianning and Tengyue were all malarial regions where regular troops were hard to station, sixteen hundred local militiamen were trained—eight hundred garrisoning Bingyeshanliang and other places in Mianning, and eight hundred garrisoning Manzhangshan and other places in Tengyue—sparing regular troops the labor of constant mobilization.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year of Jiaqing, wild Yi and Luo bandits beyond Yunnan's borders were raiding freely, while the passes at Mianning and Tengyue were malarial country where regular garrisons could not be maintained. Sixteen hundred local militiamen were therefore trained—eight hundred posted at Bingyeshanliang and other points in Mianning, eight hundred at Manzhangshan and elsewhere in Tengyue—relieving regular troops of constant call-ups.

sentences.zh: 其時苗疆底定，亦增設鄉兵，凡屯丁七千人，訓練之暇，開墾屯防田數十萬頃。

translations.literal: At that time, with the Miao frontier pacified, local militia were also expanded; there were seven thousand garrison militiamen who, in intervals between training, opened and reclaimed several hundred thousand qing of garrison-defense farmland.
translations.idiomatic: By then the Miao frontier had been settled, and local militia were expanded as well: seven thousand garrison militiamen who, between drills, opened several hundred thousand qing of defensive farmland.

sentences.zh: 道光二年，令直隸疆臣招集團練，修築土堡，互為策應。

translations.literal: In the second year of Daoguang, frontier officials in Zhili were ordered to recruit militia companies, build earthen forts, and support one another in mutual coordination.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Daoguang, Zhili's frontier officials were ordered to raise militia companies, build earthen forts, and coordinate mutual support.

sentences.zh: 十五年，令各州縣額設民壯，一律充補訓練，復令各省民壯每月隨營操演，范以紀律。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, each prefecture and county was ordered to establish quotas of civilian strongmen, fill and train them uniformly, and furthermore each province's civilian strongmen were to drill monthly with the camps and be bound by discipline.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year, every prefecture and county was required to maintain a quota of civilian strongmen, fill vacancies, and train them uniformly; provinces were also ordered to have these men drill monthly with the camps under strict discipline.

sentences.zh: 是年，調大小金川鄉兵千名，給以千人之糧，隨營征戰，歸屯則仍食五百人之糧。

translations.literal: That same year, one thousand local militiamen from Greater and Lesser Jinchuan were mobilized, paid rations for one thousand men when campaigning with the army, and upon return to garrison still received rations for five hundred men.
translations.idiomatic: That same year, one thousand local militiamen from Greater and Lesser Jinchuan were called up with full rations for a thousand men while on campaign; when they returned to garrison duty, they were paid at half strength.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，令山東巡撫於蓬萊、黃縣、榮成、寧海、掖縣、膠州、即墨所屬之十三梟，編練鄉兵，互相防衛。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year, the Shandong governor was ordered to organize and train local militia in the thirteen districts under Penglai, Huangxian, Rongcheng, Ninghai, Yexian, Jiaozhou, and Jimo for mutual defense.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year, the Shandong governor was ordered to organize and drill local militia in thirteen districts under Penglai, Huangxian, Rongcheng, Ninghai, Yexian, Jiaozhou, and Jimo for mutual defense.

sentences.zh: 又令沿海疆臣仿浙江定海縣土堡之法，凡近海村落，招募鄉兵，興築土堡，以聯聲勢。

translations.literal: Coastal frontier officials were also ordered to follow the method of earthen forts in Dinghai County, Zhejiang: in every seaside village, recruit local militia and build earthen forts to extend defensive reach.
translations.idiomatic: Coastal officials were also told to follow the earthen-fort model used in Dinghai County, Zhejiang: recruit local militia in seaside villages and build earthworks to extend their defensive reach.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，令廣東省以團練助防海口。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, Guangdong Province was ordered to use militia companies to assist in defending Haikou.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year, Guangdong was ordered to use militia companies to help defend Haikou.

sentences.zh: 旋疆吏疏言廣東民風宜於鄉團，招集已得十萬人，以昇平學社為團練總匯之區，推及韶州、廉州等處，一律舉行。

translations.literal: Soon after, frontier officials memorialized that Guangdong's local customs were suited to village militia; one hundred thousand men had already been recruited, with the Shengping Academy society as the central coordinating district for militia training, and the practice was extended uniformly to Shaozhou, Lianzhou, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward, provincial officials reported that Guangdong's local customs favored village militia: one hundred thousand men had already been enrolled, with the Shengping Academy society serving as the central hub, and the program was extended uniformly to Shaozhou, Lianzhou, and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，令各州縣民壯隨營考察技藝。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, civilian strongmen in each prefecture and county were ordered to have their skills examined during camp drills.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year, every prefecture and county was ordered to test civilian strongmen on their skills during camp drills.

sentences.zh: 是年，甘肅沿邊番賊肆擾，令疆臣召募獵戶千人，編為一軍，供遠探近防之用。

translations.literal: That same year, frontier bandits along Gansu's borders raided wantonly; frontier officials were ordered to recruit one thousand hunter troops, organized as one army, for long-range reconnaissance and local defense.
translations.idiomatic: That same year, frontier raiders along Gansu's borders were running wild, and officials were ordered to recruit one thousand hunter militiamen as a single corps for long-range scouting and local defense.

sentences.zh: 及道光季年，張國樑募廣東潮州鄉兵追逐粵寇，轉戰東下，卒以獷悍不馴，遂至潰散。

translations.literal: By the late Daoguang period, Zhang Guoliang recruited local militia from Chaozhou, Guangdong, to pursue the Cantonese rebels, fighting eastward as they went; ultimately, because they were fierce and unruly, they broke up and dispersed.
translations.idiomatic: Near the end of the Daoguang reign, Zhang Guoliang raised Chaozhou militia from Guangdong to chase the Cantonese rebels eastward, but their ferocity proved impossible to control, and the force eventually collapsed and scattered.

sentences.zh: 咸豐二年，令在籍侍郎曾國籓辦理湖南鄉團。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xianfeng, Vice Minister Zeng Guofan, on home leave, was ordered to manage Hunan's village militia.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Xianfeng, Vice Minister Zeng Guofan, then at home on leave, was ordered to organize Hunan's village militia.

sentences.zh: 旋國籓疏言先行練勇一千人，所辦者乃官勇非團丁，是為鄉團改勇營之始。

translations.literal: Soon after, Zeng memorialized that he would first train one thousand braves; what he was organizing were official braves, not village militiamen—this marked the beginning of converting village militia into brave battalions.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng soon reported that he would begin by drilling one thousand braves—official troops, not village militiamen—and this marked the first step in turning village companies into formal brave battalions.

sentences.zh: 三年，令山東登、萊、青三府舉辦聯庄團練，給以兵械。

translations.literal: In the third year, the three prefectures of Deng, Lai, and Qing in Shandong were ordered to establish linked-village militia training and were supplied with weapons.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, the three Shandong prefectures of Deng, Lai, and Qing were ordered to organize linked-village militia and were issued arms.

sentences.zh: 四年，令甘肅沿邊增募獵戶三千人以防番騎。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, Gansu's frontier regions were ordered to expand hunter recruitment to three thousand men to guard against frontier cavalry raids.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, Gansu's frontier was ordered to expand hunter recruitment to three thousand men to guard against frontier cavalry raids.

sentences.zh: 八年，安徽巡撫翁同書疏言皖省定遠、壽州、合肥等縣舉辦團練，旬日之間，遠近響應，和州踞賊屢出焚掠，多被鄉團擊回，以其深明大義，踴躍同仇，凡董事團總人等，傳諭嘉勉。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, Anhui Governor Weng Tongshu memorialized that Dingyuan, Shouzhou, Hefei, and other counties in Anhui had raised militia training; within ten days responses came from near and far. Rebels holding Hexian repeatedly sortied to burn and plunder, but were mostly driven back by village militia. Because they clearly understood the greater cause and eagerly shared the common enmity, all directors, militia chiefs, and the like were commended by imperial message.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, Anhui Governor Weng Tongshu reported that Dingyuan, Shouzhou, Hefei, and other counties had raised militia companies, and within ten days the response spread far and wide. Rebels holding Hexian repeatedly sallied out to burn and loot, but village militia drove most of them back. Because the organizers clearly grasped the larger cause and rallied with shared resolve, the directors and militia chiefs were commended by imperial message.

sentences.zh: 九年，河南巡撫恆福疏言，皖寇進偪豫境，令道府大員於接近皖寇之地，舉辦鄉團，睢州等州縣興築堡寨已數十處。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, Henan Governor Hengfu memorialized that Anhui rebels were pressing close to Henan's borders; circuit and prefectural officials were ordered to organize village militia in areas near the Anhui rebels, and in Suizhou and other prefectures and counties several dozen fortifications had already been built.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, Henan Governor Hengfu reported that Anhui rebels were closing on Henan's border and ordered circuit and prefectural officials to organize village militia in threatened districts; in Suizhou and other counties, several dozen fortifications had already been raised.

sentences.zh: 旋諭河南官紳訓練鄉勇，聯村築寨，迅速舉行。

translations.literal: An edict soon followed instructing Henan's officials and gentry to train local braves, link villages in building stockades, and carry this out swiftly.
translations.idiomatic: An edict soon followed instructing Henan's officials and gentry to train local braves, link villages with fortified stockades, and act without delay.

sentences.zh: 十年，諭勝保等督辦鄉團，以資統率，酌定章程，凡辦團州縣一律遵行，惟鄉團更番調營，所領糧餉，易滋流弊，毋得冒濫。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, Senggebao and others were ordered to supervise village militia for unified command; regulations were drawn up for all counties organizing militia to follow uniformly. However, when village militia rotated in turns to camp duty, the rations they received easily bred abuses, and padding must not be allowed.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, Senggebao and others were appointed to oversee village militia and draw up regulations for every participating county—but when militia rotated through camp duty, rations were easily abused, and padding the rolls was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 又諭：「江蘇等省在籍紳士，除已經辦理團練外，其明曉大義律身公正者，自不乏人，所有在京直隸、江蘇、安徽、浙江、河南等省之大小官員，將如何舉行鄉團，隨同官兵剿賊，及防守等一切事宜，各陳所見，各舉所知，迅即上聞。」

translations.literal: Another edict stated: 'Among gentry on home leave in Jiangsu and other provinces, besides those who have already organized militia training, there are certainly no lack of men who understand the greater cause and conduct themselves with integrity. All officials from Zhili, Jiangsu, Anhui, Zhejiang, Henan, and other provinces now in the capital, large and small, shall state their views on how to organize village militia, join regular troops in suppressing rebels, and on all matters of defense; each shall recommend those he knows, and report swiftly.'
translations.idiomatic: Another edict declared: 'Among gentry on home leave in Jiangsu and other provinces, beyond those already organizing militia, there are surely many who understand the larger cause and conduct themselves with integrity. Every official from Zhili, Jiangsu, Anhui, Zhejiang, Henan, and other provinces now in the capital, high or low, shall report how village militia should be organized, how they should join regular troops in suppressing rebels, and how defense should be handled; each shall recommend capable men and report at once.'

sentences.zh: 尋侍郎沈兆霖疏陳：「自咸豐三年以後，迭奉朝旨舉行鄉團，已至再至三，各省官紳士民，未嘗不遵旨辦理，而賊勢披猖，卒無成效。

translations.literal: Soon after, Vice Minister Shen Zhaolin memorialized: 'Since the third year of Xianfeng, imperial orders to organize village militia have been issued again and again, even a third time; officials, gentry, and commoners in each province have not failed to comply, yet rebel strength has run rampant and in the end there has been no effect.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward, Vice Minister Shen Zhaolin memorialized: 'Since the third year of Xianfeng, the court has ordered village militia raised again and again—two times, three times—and officials, gentry, and commoners in every province have obeyed, yet the rebels have only grown bolder and the effort has come to nothing.

sentences.zh: 良由苟且塗飾，未經實力講求，或募勇以充數，徒取外觀，或藉端以營私，轉成欲壑，無事則恃為威脅，擾害鄉閭，有警則首先遁逃，流為盜賊。

translations.literal: The reason truly lay in perfunctory window-dressing without earnest effort: some recruited braves merely to fill numbers and took appearance alone; some used the pretext to pursue private gain, turning it into a bottomless pit; in peacetime they relied on it as a threat and harassed the countryside; when alarm came they fled first and turned into bandits.
translations.idiomatic: The trouble was superficial compliance without real effort: some hired braves merely to pad the rolls and put on a show; others used militia as a pretext for private profit until the scheme became insatiable. In quiet times they bullied their neighbors; when danger came they were the first to flee and turned to banditry.

sentences.zh: 議者幾謂鄉團之無益而有損矣。

translations.literal: Commentators nearly concluded that village militia were useless and harmful.
translations.idiomatic: Critics were close to declaring village militia worthless at best and harmful at worst.

sentences.zh: 不知名為民團，即當以民為團，而不可以募勇塞責也。

translations.literal: They failed to understand that what is called a people's militia must be built from the people themselves, and that hired braves cannot be used to fulfill the obligation.
translations.idiomatic: They missed the point: what is called a people's militia must be made of the people themselves, not filled out with hired braves as a substitute.

sentences.zh: 民統於紳，則紳之邪正宜慎擇也。

translations.literal: Since the people are organized under the gentry, the integrity of the gentry must be chosen with care.
translations.idiomatic: Because commoners fall under gentry leadership, the character of those gentry must be chosen with care.

sentences.zh: 紳倚於官，則官之賢否宜嚴辨也。

translations.literal: Since the gentry rely on officials, the merit of officials must be strictly distinguished.
translations.idiomatic: Because gentry depend on officials, the quality of those officials must be strictly assessed.

sentences.zh: 不歸併於一路，則督察無人，必不能一律堅固。

translations.literal: If not consolidated under a single command, there is no one to oversee matters and unity and firmness cannot be maintained throughout.
translations.idiomatic: Without unified command, there is no one to oversee the effort, and cohesion cannot be maintained.

sentences.zh: 不專力於四鄉，則城守雖嚴，已難免四面受敵。

translations.literal: If effort is not concentrated on the four surrounding countryside districts, then even if city defense is strict, one cannot avoid being attacked from all sides.
translations.idiomatic: If effort is not concentrated on the surrounding countryside, even the strictest city defenses cannot prevent attack from every direction.

sentences.zh: 官與紳宜兩相孚，不宜兩相阨。

translations.literal: Officials and gentry should trust one another; they should not obstruct one another.
translations.idiomatic: Officials and gentry should trust one another, not work at cross purposes.

sentences.zh: 兵與民宜兩相顧，不宜兩相仇。

translations.literal: Soldiers and civilians should look out for one another; they should not become mutual enemies.
translations.idiomatic: Soldiers and civilians should look out for one another, not become enemies.

sentences.zh: 任封疆者，當知民本吾民，用兵數少，何如用民數多。

translations.literal: Those charged with frontier governance should know that the people are their own people; what is the use of a few soldiers compared with using many civilians?
translations.idiomatic: Frontier governors should remember that the people are their own people—a few soldiers are no match for mobilizing the many.

sentences.zh: 任將帥者，當知兵本吾民，我能救民，自然民能救我。

translations.literal: Those charged with command should know that troops are drawn from the people; if I can save the people, naturally the people can save me.
translations.idiomatic: Commanders should remember that their troops come from the people: if I save the people, the people will save me.

sentences.zh: 現在賊氛猖獗，非實辦民團，更無安全之法。」

translations.literal: At present rebel strength is rampant; unless people's militia are genuinely organized, there is no other method of safety.'
translations.idiomatic: With rebels raging as they do now, there is no path to safety except genuinely organizing people's militia.'

sentences.zh: 乃擬上事宜十二條：「一、民團須招本地有業之民，不可招市井無賴也。

translations.literal: He then drafted twelve recommendations for submission: 'First, people's militia must recruit local people with legitimate occupations; street riffraff must not be recruited.
translations.idiomatic: He then drafted twelve recommendations: 'First, people's militia must recruit local people with honest livelihoods, not street riffraff.

sentences.zh: 一、宜分別地段，以近賊一、二百里為最要，距賊稍遠，中隔一、二縣者為次要，其遠在三、四百里外者，則從緩辦團也。

translations.literal: Second, areas should be distinguished: within one to two hundred li of the rebels is most critical; somewhat farther away, separated by one or two counties, is secondary; those three or four hundred li away may organize militia more slowly.
translations.idiomatic: Second, areas should be prioritized by distance: one to two hundred li from the rebels is most urgent; one or two counties farther back is secondary; three or four hundred li away may be organized more slowly.

sentences.zh: 一、各州縣要地，宜一律辦團，無使一處疏漏，俾寇得乘隙而入也。

translations.literal: Third, key places in each prefecture and county should all organize militia uniformly, with no place left uncovered, lest bandits exploit a gap to enter.
translations.idiomatic: Third, every key point in each prefecture and county should organize militia, leaving no gap through which bandits might slip.

sentences.zh: 一、辦團宜四鄉加密，有警則互相應援，無事則嚴詰姦宄，庶城守完固也。

translations.literal: Fourth, militia organization should be denser in the four surrounding countryside districts; when alarm comes they should support one another, and in peacetime strictly investigate infiltrators, so that city defense may be complete and firm.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth, militia should be thicker in the surrounding countryside: mutual support when alarm sounds, strict scrutiny of infiltrators in quiet times, so that city defenses hold firm.

sentences.zh: 一、牧令宜擇賢能，與辦團之紳，不得各存意見，亦不得任用劣紳也。

translations.literal: Fifth, magistrates should be chosen for ability; they and the gentry organizing militia must not each hold separate opinions, nor may unworthy gentry be employed.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth, magistrates must be capable; they and the gentry running militia must not work at cross purposes, and unworthy gentry must not be put in charge.

sentences.zh: 一、宜簡道府大員分路辦團，俾各縣聯為一氣也。

translations.literal: Sixth, senior circuit and prefectural officials should be selected to organize militia along separate routes, so that counties may be linked as one body.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth, senior circuit and prefectural officials should be appointed to organize militia by route, so counties act as one coordinated body.

sentences.zh: 一、民團有急，官兵速往救援，不得觀望也。

translations.literal: Seventh, when people's militia are in urgent need, regular troops must rush to their rescue and must not stand by and watch.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh, when militia are in danger, regular troops must rush to their aid without hesitation.

sentences.zh: 一、宜擇要設卡盤查也。

translations.literal: Eighth, strategic checkpoints should be established for inspection.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth, strategic checkpoints should be set up for inspection.

sentences.zh: 一、民團祗可就地助戰，不宜調遣，變為練勇，失其恆業也。

translations.literal: Ninth, people's militia may only assist in fighting locally; they should not be redeployed and turned into trained braves, losing their regular livelihoods.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth, militia should fight only as local auxiliaries; they must not be redeployed as trained braves and stripped of their regular livelihoods.

sentences.zh: 一、立功宜即獎勵，視官兵稍優也。

translations.literal: Tenth, meritorious service should be rewarded immediately, with terms slightly better than those for regular troops.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth, meritorious service should be rewarded at once, on terms slightly better than those for regular troops.

sentences.zh: 一、團費宜自捐自辦，不得藉端漁利也。

translations.literal: Eleventh, militia expenses should be raised and managed by voluntary local contribution; they must not become a pretext for profiteering.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh, militia funds should come from voluntary local contributions, not become a pretext for profiteering.

sentences.zh: 一、民團辦成，則分防之兵可省，集合成軍，攻剿更為得力也。」

translations.literal: Twelfth, once people's militia are established, garrison troops for local defense may be reduced; gathered into an army, offensive suppression becomes more effective.'
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth, once militia are in place, garrison troops can be reduced and concentrated for more effective offensive campaigns.'

sentences.zh: 同時應詔陳言者，有載垣等所議團練章程十條，賈楨等所擬辦理章程八條。

translations.literal: At the same time, among those who responded to the edict with memorials were ten militia regulations proposed by Zaiyuan and others, and eight implementation regulations drafted by Jia Zhen and others.
translations.idiomatic: Others responding to the edict included ten militia regulations proposed by Zaiyuan and colleagues, and eight implementation rules drafted by Jia Zhen and others.

sentences.zh: 旋命順天府府丞毛昶熙為督辦河南團練大臣，南汝光道鄭元善幫辦團練事宜，按照怡親王載垣等所擬章程辦理。

translations.literal: Mao Changxi, Vice Prefect of Shuntian Prefecture, was soon appointed Supervisor of Henan Militia Training; Zheng Yuanshan of the Nanyang-Ruzhou-Guangzhou Circuit was assigned to assist in militia affairs, following the regulations proposed by Prince Yi Zaiyuan and others.
translations.idiomatic: Mao Changxi, Vice Prefect of Shuntian Prefecture, was soon appointed to oversee Henan militia, with Zheng Yuanshan of the Nanyang-Ruzhou-Guangzhou Circuit assisting, under the regulations proposed by Prince Yi Zaiyuan and others.

sentences.zh: 命戶部右侍郎杜為督辦山東團練大臣，登萊青道貢璜、登州府知府盧朝安幫辦團練事宜，按照大學士賈楨等所擬條款，並參酌河南章程，體察情形辦理。

translations.literal: Du, Vice Minister of the Ministry of Revenue, was appointed Supervisor of Shandong Militia Training; Gong Huang of the Dengzhou-Laizhou-Qingzhou Circuit and Lu Chao'an, Prefect of Dengzhou Prefecture, were assigned to assist in militia affairs, implementing the provisions drafted by Grand Secretary Jia Zhen and others while also adapting Henan's regulations to local conditions.
translations.idiomatic: Du, Vice Minister of the Ministry of Revenue, was appointed to oversee Shandong militia, with Gong Huang of the Dengzhou-Laizhou-Qingzhou Circuit and Lu Chao'an, Prefect of Dengzhou, assisting under the provisions drafted by Grand Secretary Jia Zhen and others, adapted from Henan's model to local conditions.

sentences.zh: 又以皖南地方緊要，應一律辦團，令兩江總督曾國籓察看情形，擇其諳練軍務素有人望者，酌保一人，即令督辦皖南團練事宜。

translations.literal: Because southern Anhui was a critical region where militia should be organized uniformly, Governor-General Zeng Guofan of the Two Jiangs was ordered to assess conditions, select one person experienced in military affairs and long respected, recommend him for appointment, and have him supervise southern Anhui militia affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Because southern Anhui was critical and militia should be organized throughout the region, Governor-General Zeng Guofan was ordered to assess conditions, nominate one experienced and respected figure, and put him in charge of southern Anhui militia.

sentences.zh: 旋曾國籓覆陳：「鄉團本是良法，然奉行不善，縣官徒藉以斂費，局紳亦從而分肥，賊至則先行潰逃，賊退則重加苛派，轉為地方之弊。

translations.literal: Soon after, Zeng Guofan replied: 'Village militia were originally a sound method, but when poorly implemented, county magistrates used them merely to collect fees and bureau gentry shared in the spoils; when rebels came they fled first, and when rebels retreated they imposed harsh levies anew, turning the practice into a local scourge.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng soon replied: 'Village militia were sound in principle, but poor execution turned them into a local curse—magistrates used them to levy fees, bureau gentry shared the spoils, men fled at the first sign of rebels, and after the enemy withdrew they imposed harsh new levies.

sentences.zh: 所經過各省，從未見有鄉團能專打一股、專克一城者，不過隨官兵之後，勝則貪財，敗則先奔，常藉口於工食之太少。

translations.literal: In every province he had passed through, he had never seen village militia able independently to defeat a rebel band or capture a city; they merely followed regular troops, grabbing spoils in victory and fleeing first in defeat, always complaining that their rations were too meager.
translations.idiomatic: In every province he had passed through, he had never seen village militia independently defeat a rebel band or take a city—they merely trailed regular troops, grabbing loot in victory and running first in defeat, always complaining their rations were too small.

sentences.zh: 而辦理歧異者，每多給錢文，團丁所領之餉，與官勇例價相同，且有過之。

translations.literal: Where implementation varied, cash payments were often generous; the pay received by militiamen matched the standard rate for official braves, and sometimes exceeded it.
translations.idiomatic: Where practice varied, militiamen often received cash payments matching—or exceeding—the standard rate for official braves.

sentences.zh: 其取之民間，無非勸捐抽釐之類。

translations.literal: What was taken from the people was nothing other than voluntary donations, levy extractions, and the like.
translations.idiomatic: The money came from the people through voluntary donations, levy extractions, and similar measures.

sentences.zh: 是於團練已失其本義，于軍餉又大有妨礙。

translations.literal: Thus militia training had lost its original meaning, and military finances were greatly obstructed.
translations.idiomatic: In this way militia training lost its original purpose and military finances were seriously undermined.

sentences.zh: 今奉諭舉行皖南團練，皖南嶺隘紛歧，若築碉設卡，有險可憑，徽、寧各要隘，宜擇地築碉，以資防守。

translations.literal: Now, ordered to organize southern Anhui militia: southern Anhui's mountain passes branch in many directions; if blockhouses and checkpoints are built, defensible terrain can be relied upon; at each key pass in Huizhou and Ningguo, sites should be chosen to build blockhouses for defense.
translations.idiomatic: Now ordered to organize southern Anhui militia: the region's mountain passes branch in every direction, and blockhouses and checkpoints built on defensible ground would serve well—key passes in Huizhou and Ningguo should each have blockhouses sited for defense.

sentences.zh: 有在籍翰林院編修宋夢蘭當賊由太平縣竄擾徽州，宋夢蘭督帶練丁協力嚴守，眾論翕然。

translations.literal: There was Hanlin Academy Compiler Song Menglan, on home leave, who when rebels from Taiping County raided into Huizhou supervised trained militiamen in a joint, vigorous defense; public opinion was unanimous in his praise.
translations.idiomatic: Hanlin Academy Compiler Song Menglan, then at home on leave, had supervised trained militiamen in a stout defense when rebels from Taiping County raided Huizhou, winning unanimous public praise.

sentences.zh: 請即以該員辦理皖南團練事宜，會同委員，董勸各屬紳民，興築碉塞。

translations.literal: He requested that this official be appointed to manage southern Anhui militia affairs, working with commissioners to urge gentry and commoners in each subordinate district to build fortifications.
translations.idiomatic: He recommended appointing Song to manage southern Anhui militia, working with commissioners to urge local gentry and people to build fortifications.

sentences.zh: 其未經克復者，官兵攻剿，概不令團丁隨往。

translations.literal: In areas not yet recovered, regular troops would conduct offensive suppression and militiamen would generally not be sent along.
translations.idiomatic: In areas not yet recovered, regular troops would conduct offensives without bringing militiamen along.

sentences.zh: 其已經克復者，紳耆修碉，團丁守之。

translations.literal: In areas already recovered, elder gentry would build blockhouses and militiamen would garrison them.
translations.idiomatic: In recovered areas, elder gentry would build blockhouses and militiamen would garrison them.

sentences.zh: 庶幾軍民兩利，名實相符矣。」

translations.literal: Thus both military and civilian interests might benefit, and name and reality would correspond.'
translations.idiomatic: In this way both military and civilian interests would be served, and practice would match principle.'

sentences.zh: 又以四川地屬岩疆，毗連雲、貴，滇匪滋擾，未能肅清。

translations.literal: It was also noted that Sichuan's terrain was rugged frontier country, bordering Yunnan and Guizhou, where Yunnan bandits continued to raid and had not yet been fully pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan's rugged terrain bordered Yunnan and Guizhou, where Yunnan bandits continued to raid and full pacification had not been achieved.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶間，四川舉辦鄉團，行堅壁清野之法，著有成效，自應仿辦。

translations.literal: During the Jiaqing period, Sichuan had organized village militia and applied the method of fortified villages and cleared countryside with notable success; this should naturally be emulated.
translations.idiomatic: During Jiaqing, Sichuan had organized village militia and applied scorched-earth tactics with notable success, and the model should be followed.

sentences.zh: 所有應行事宜，諭四川在京各員，就地方情形，各抒所見。

translations.literal: On all matters that should be carried out, Sichuan officials in the capital were instructed to state their views according to local conditions.
translations.idiomatic: On all relevant measures, Sichuan officials then in the capital were instructed to report their views based on local conditions.

sentences.zh: 官紳中有練達時務者，各舉所知，以俟後命。

translations.literal: Among officials and gentry who were experienced in current affairs, each was to recommend those he knew, pending further orders.
translations.idiomatic: Officials and gentry with practical experience were to recommend capable men, pending further orders.

sentences.zh: 同時尚書陳孚恩等以江西毗連安徽、浙江、廣東等省，疏請辦理團練，酌保辦事人員，並擬團練事宜八條。

translations.literal: At the same time, Minister Chen Fu'en and others, noting that Jiangxi bordered Anhui, Zhejiang, Guangdong, and other provinces, memorialized requesting militia training, recommending personnel for the work, and drafting eight regulations for militia affairs.
translations.idiomatic: At the same time, Minister Chen Fu'en noted that Jiangxi bordered Anhui, Zhejiang, and Guangdong, and memorialized for militia organization, recommending personnel and proposing eight regulations.

sentences.zh: 疏入，允行。

translations.literal: The memorial was submitted and approved.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was approved.

sentences.zh: 命在籍翰林院修撰劉繹為江西督辦團練大臣，吉南贛寧道沈葆楨、甘肅安肅道劉於潯幫辦團練事宜，按照陳孚恩等所擬章程，妥為辦理。

translations.literal: Hanlin Academy Compiler Liu Yi, on home leave, was appointed Supervisor of Jiangxi Militia Training; Shen Baozhen of the Ji'an-Nan'an-Ganzhou Circuit and Liu Yuxun of the Gansu Anxi-Suzhou Circuit were assigned to assist in militia affairs, implementing the regulations proposed by Chen Fu'en and others properly.
translations.idiomatic: Hanlin Academy Compiler Liu Yi, on home leave, was appointed to oversee Jiangxi militia, with Shen Baozhen of the Ji'an-Nan'an-Ganzhou Circuit and Liu Yuxun of the Gansu Anxi-Suzhou Circuit assisting under Chen Fu'en's regulations.

sentences.zh: 同時督辦河南團練大臣、順天府府丞毛昶熙疏陳團練辦法，並酌擬規條：一、添築堡寨以扼要隘，一、講求險要以便堵御，一、慎擇首事以資統率，一、分選團丁以備訓練，一、攤派練費以備公用，一、互為聲援以資聯絡，一、申明號令以壹眾志，一、嚴定約束以禁頑暴，一、秉公賞罰以示勸懲，一、嚴察姦宄以防內應，一、旌表忠義以作民氣，一、事貴實力以冀成功。

translations.literal: At the same time, Mao Changxi, Supervisor of Henan Militia Training and Vice Prefect of Shuntian Prefecture, memorialized on militia methods and drafted provisional regulations: first, add and build fortifications to control key passes; second, exploit strategic terrain for blocking defense; third, choose leaders carefully for unified command; fourth, select militiamen separately for training; fifth, apportion training expenses for public use; sixth, extend mutual support for coordination; seventh, clarify commands to unify popular resolve; eighth, strictly set constraints to restrain violence; ninth, reward and punish impartially to show encouragement and deterrence; tenth, strictly investigate infiltrators to guard against internal collusion; eleventh, honor loyalty and righteousness to rouse popular spirit; twelfth, value practical effort in hope of success.
translations.idiomatic: At the same time, Mao Changxi, minister supervising Henan militia training and vice prefect of Shuntian, memorialized on militia methods and drafted regulations: build additional forts and stockades to control key passes; study strategic terrain for blocking and defense; choose leaders carefully to provide command; select militiamen by category for training; apportion training expenses for public use; give mutual support to maintain coordination; clarify commands to unify the people's resolve; set strict restraints to forbid violence and disorder; reward and punish impartially to encourage and deter; investigate traitors and criminals strictly to guard against internal collusion; honor loyalty and righteousness to rouse the people's spirit; and value practical strength in order to hope for success.

sentences.zh: 疏入，允行。

translations.literal: The memorial was submitted and approved.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was approved.

sentences.zh: 毛昶熙又疏陳河南團練，以歸、陳二府為先。

translations.literal: Mao Changxi further memorialized on Henan militia, giving priority to the two prefectures of Gui and Chen.
translations.idiomatic: Mao Changxi further reported that Henan militia should begin in the Gui and Chen prefectures.

sentences.zh: 前統兵大臣勝保，因調團不齊，勒派百姓出資雇丁，統計勇糧運費，較正供多至倍蓰，百姓苦累，紛紛稟請，以抽丁一項，民力已竭，鄉團勢難再辦。

translations.literal: The former commander Senggebao, because militia mobilization was incomplete, had forced commoners to contribute funds to hire braves; counting brave rations and transport costs, the total exceeded regular revenue by as much as several times; the people suffered grievously and petitioned in numbers, stating that conscription alone had exhausted popular strength and that village militia could hardly be organized again.
translations.idiomatic: Former commander Senggebao, unable to mobilize militia uniformly, had forced commoners to fund hired braves—grain and transport costs ran to several times normal revenue. The people petitioned in droves that conscription alone had exhausted them and village militia could no longer be raised.

sentences.zh: 其開封等府百姓聞歸、陳雇勇之苦，亦復觀望，不肯實辦。

translations.literal: The people of Kaifeng and other prefectures, hearing of the hardships of hiring braves in Gui and Chen, likewise held back and were unwilling to implement it in earnest.
translations.idiomatic: When the people of Kaifeng and other prefectures heard how hiring braves had burdened Gui and Chen, they too held back and refused to organize militia in earnest.

sentences.zh: 團練之事，仍恐有名無實。

translations.literal: Militia training still risked being nominal in name without substance in practice.
translations.idiomatic: There was still every reason to fear that militia training would exist in name only.

sentences.zh: 尋奉諭：「用民之法，總宜深得民心。

translations.literal: Soon an edict followed: 'Methods of using the people should always win the people's hearts deeply.
translations.idiomatic: An edict soon followed: 'Any policy that mobilizes the people must first win their hearts.

sentences.zh: 勝保等所辦章程既與民心不洽，自應改弦更張，以期得力。

translations.literal: Since the regulations organized by Senggebao and others did not accord with popular sentiment, a change of approach was naturally required to achieve effectiveness.
translations.idiomatic: Because the regulations Senggebao and others had drawn up ran against popular sentiment, the policy had to be changed if it was to work.

sentences.zh: 慶廉即體察情形，將此項雇勇酌量裁撤。

translations.literal: Qing Lian was to assess conditions and appropriately reduce and abolish these hired braves.
translations.idiomatic: Qing Lian was to assess local conditions and cut back these hired braves as appropriate.

sentences.zh: 毛昶熙按照載垣等會議章程，速即集團練勇，以輔兵力。」

translations.literal: Mao Changxi, following the conference regulations of Zaiyuan and others, was to quickly gather militia braves to supplement military strength.'
translations.idiomatic: Mao Changxi was to follow the regulations agreed on by Zaiyuan and others and quickly raise militia braves to reinforce regular troops.'

sentences.zh: 又以甘肅控制西陲，地方遼闊，且與陝西、四川毗連，匪患未靖，自應一律舉辦團練，以靖邊陲。

translations.literal: It was further noted that Gansu controlled the western frontier, the territory was vast, and it bordered Shaanxi and Sichuan; bandit troubles were not yet pacified, so militia training should uniformly be organized to quiet the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: Gansu, moreover, guarded the western frontier across a vast territory bordering Shaanxi and Sichuan; with banditry still unsettled, militia should be organized throughout the province to secure the border.

sentences.zh: 所有甘肅省團練事宜，即命陝甘總督樂斌督辦，並命甘涼道蕭浚蘭、刑部員外郎吳可讀、江西候補道楊升幫辦團練。

translations.literal: All Gansu militia affairs were assigned to Shaanxi-Gansu Governor-General Yue Bin to supervise, with Xiao Junlan of the Gansu-Liangzhou Circuit, Wu Kedu, Department Director in the Ministry of Justice, and Yang Sheng, Jiangxi Expectant Circuit Intendant, assigned to assist.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Yue Bin of Shaanxi-Gansu was put in charge of Gansu militia, assisted by Xiao Junlan of the Gansu-Liangzhou Circuit, Wu Kedu of the Ministry of Justice, and Yang Sheng, an expectant circuit intendant from Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 十一年，以歸化之番眾僧俗兵四千餘人，馬四千餘匹，防禦抱罕羌人。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, more than four thousand monastic and lay frontier troops of the Guihua tribes and more than four thousand horses were deployed to defend against the Baohan Qiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, more than four thousand monastic and lay frontier troops from the Guihua tribes, with more than four thousand horses, were posted to guard against the Baohan Qiang.

sentences.zh: 是年，奉諭：「鄉團之設，原以濟兵力所不逮。

translations.literal: That year, an edict stated: 'Village militia were originally established to supplement what regular military strength could not reach.
translations.idiomatic: That same year an edict declared: 'Village militia were meant to fill the gaps regular troops could not cover.

sentences.zh: 必須官紳一體，兵勇同心協力，內靖土匪，外御賊氛，於地方庶有裨益。

translations.literal: Officials and gentry must act as one, soldiers and braves must cooperate with shared resolve, pacifying internal bandits and repelling external rebel threats—only then could the locality benefit.
translations.idiomatic: Officials and gentry must stand together, soldiers and militiamen must fight as one—pacifying local bandits within and repelling rebels without—if the locality is to gain any real benefit.

sentences.zh: 若如清盛疏劾山東章丘縣之水賽街、新城之南婁里等庄，以及博山、萊蕪等縣鄉團，遇有經過客商，往來差役，輒敢擅行殺戮，害及無辜。

translations.literal: If, as Qing Sheng impeached in memorial regarding villages such as Shuisai Street in Zhangqiu County and Nanlouli in Xincheng in Shandong, as well as village militia in Boshan, Laiwu, and other counties—when traveling merchants or passing runners and couriers passed through, they dared to kill without authorization, harming the innocent—
translations.idiomatic: But if, as Qing Sheng charged in memorial, village militia in places such as Shuisai Street in Zhangqiu County, Nanlouli in Xincheng, and Boshan and Laiwu counties dared to kill passing merchants and government couriers without authority, harming the innocent—

sentences.zh: 撫署之差弁馬匹，亦被劫奪。

translations.literal: Even the couriers and horses of the governor's office were robbed.
translations.idiomatic: Even couriers and horses from the governor's own office were robbed.

sentences.zh: 是團練御賊尚無成效，而抗官滋事竟有滋蔓之勢。

translations.literal: Thus militia training had achieved nothing against bandits, while resistance to officials and creating disturbances were spreading.
translations.idiomatic: Then militia had done nothing against bandits, while defiance of officials and local disorder were spreading.

sentences.zh: 巡撫譚廷襄速將清盛所奏各情，嚴密查訪。

translations.literal: Governor Tan Tingxiang was ordered quickly to conduct a strict investigation of all matters reported by Qing Sheng.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Tan Tingxiang was ordered to investigate promptly and thoroughly every charge Qing Sheng had raised.

sentences.zh: 如有藉團為名，肆行不法，及私立黑團，聚眾抗官，立即嚴懲。」

translations.literal: If anyone used militia as a pretext to act unlawfully, or privately established illegal militia bands and gathered crowds to resist officials, they were to be immediately punished severely.'
translations.idiomatic: Anyone who used militia as a cover for lawlessness, or who formed illegal private militia and gathered crowds to resist officials, was to be punished at once.'

sentences.zh: 又諭浙江巡撫：「前以浙省軍務未平，籌辦團練，勸諭捐輸，原以保衛民生。

translations.literal: Another edict to the Zhejiang governor: 'Previously, because military affairs in Zhejiang were unsettled, militia was organized and donations solicited—originally to protect the people's livelihood.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict to the Zhejiang governor: 'Militia and donations were organized earlier because Zhejiang's military situation was unsettled, and the aim was to protect the people's livelihood.

sentences.zh: 若如王履謙疏劾辦團情形，雜亂無章，勸捐委員，令捐戶加捐至數十倍之多，並於捐戶加以威逼。

translations.literal: If, as Wang Luqian impeached in memorial regarding the organization of militia—disorderly and without structure, donation commissioners forcing donors to give tenfold or more, and threatening donors—
translations.idiomatic: But if, as Wang Luqian charged, militia organization was chaotic, and donation commissioners forced contributors to pay many times the expected amount while threatening them—

sentences.zh: 今賊氛逼近浙東，若因勸捐辦理不善，致失人心，必致激成內訌。

translations.literal: Now rebel strength is approaching eastern Zhejiang; if mishandled solicitation of donations loses popular support, it will surely provoke internal strife.
translations.idiomatic: With rebels now closing on eastern Zhejiang, bungled fund-raising that alienates the people will surely spark internal conflict.

sentences.zh: 巡撫王有齡速即會同王履謙妥為勸辦，議定章程，不得徇私委派貪劣之員。」

translations.literal: Governor Wang Youling was ordered quickly to consult with Wang Luqian and properly organize solicitation, draw up regulations, and not assign corrupt or inferior officials out of favoritism.'
translations.idiomatic: Governor Wang Youling was ordered to work with Wang Luqian at once, organize donations properly, set clear regulations, and appoint no corrupt or unworthy men out of favoritism.'

sentences.zh: 是年，左副都御史潘祖廕疏言：「各省設立團練大臣，辦理年餘，曾無一效，請獎請敘，紛紛效尤，並未克復一城，其為無益，已可概見。

translations.literal: That year, Left Vice Censor Pan Zuyin memorialized: 'Provincial militia supervisors have been operating for more than a year without a single success; yet requests for awards and promotions proliferate in imitation, and not one city has been recovered—their uselessness is plainly visible.
translations.idiomatic: That year Left Vice Censor Pan Zuyin memorialized: 'Provincial militia supervisors have been at work for more than a year without a single success, yet requests for rewards and promotions multiply, and not one city has been recovered—their futility is obvious.

sentences.zh: 應將團練大臣分別裁撤，以一事機而節糜費。」

translations.literal: Militia supervisors should be abolished separately to unify command and save wasteful expenditure.'
translations.idiomatic: The militia supervisors should be abolished province by province to unify command and cut waste.'

sentences.zh: 翰林院侍講學士顏宗儀疏言：「鄉團之設，原以百姓之財力，衛百姓之身家，果能眾志成城，同仇敵愾，即一舉、貢、生、監，足以統領之，無俟大員為之督率。

translations.literal: Hanlin Academy Lecturer Yan Zongyi memorialized: 'Village militia were originally established with the people's wealth to protect the people's lives and property; if the people truly unite as a wall with shared enmity, even one juren, tribute student, licentiate, or supervising student suffices to lead them—no high official need supervise.
translations.idiomatic: Hanlin Lecturer Yan Zongyi argued: 'Village militia were meant to use the people's resources to protect their lives and property. When the community truly unites with shared resolve, a single juren, tribute student, licentiate, or supervising student can lead them—no high official is needed.

sentences.zh: 若必以大僚綜任之，幫辦司員分理之，是督撫之外又設督撫，僚屬之外又增僚屬，徒滋紛擾。

translations.literal: If high officials must oversee and assistant staff divide the work, then beyond governors there are again governors, beyond subordinates again more subordinates—nothing but added disorder.
translations.idiomatic: If high officials must oversee everything and assistants divide the work, you end up with governors atop governors and subordinates atop subordinates—nothing but confusion.

sentences.zh: 上年豫省辦團，各省團練大臣亦紛紛四齣。

translations.literal: Last year when Henan organized militia, provincial militia supervisors also went out in all directions.
translations.idiomatic: When Henan organized militia the previous year, provincial militia supervisors fanned out in every direction.

sentences.zh: 旋因浙江、四川、陝西、甘肅等省情形不同，旋即裁撤。

translations.literal: Soon because conditions differed in Zhejiang, Sichuan, Shaanxi, Gansu, and other provinces, they were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward, because conditions differed in Zhejiang, Sichuan, Shaanxi, Gansu, and elsewhere, those posts were abolished.

sentences.zh: 而直隸、山東、江南、江北等處，則仍歸由團練大臣辦理。

translations.literal: But in Zhili, Shandong, Jiangnan, Jiangbei, and other places, affairs still remained under militia supervisors.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhili, Shandong, Jiangnan, Jiangbei, and other regions, however, militia still remained under the supervisors.

sentences.zh: 於是幫辦人員假公濟私，百端紛擾。

translations.literal: Thereupon assistant staff used public office for private gain, causing countless disturbances.
translations.idiomatic: Their assistants then used public office for private gain, stirring up trouble on every side.

sentences.zh: 或偪勒州縣供應，或苛派民間銀錢，或於官設捐局之外，團練再設捐局，或於官抽釐金之外，團練再抽釐金，或查閱各處團防，支應紛煩，地方告乏，或任令家人奴僕勒索規費，約束不嚴。

translations.literal: Some coerced prefectures and counties for supplies; some harshly levied money from the people; some beyond official donation bureaus, militia set up further donation bureaus; some beyond official transit levies, militia imposed further transit levies; some inspecting local militia defenses caused troublesome expenses and local shortages; some allowed family members and servants to extort fees with lax discipline.
translations.idiomatic: Some coerced prefectures and counties for supplies; some levied harsh exactions on the people; some set up donation bureaus on top of the official ones, or transit levies on top of official levies; some created endless expenses while inspecting local defenses until districts were drained; some let family members and servants extort fees because discipline was lax.

sentences.zh: 幫辦人員或十餘人，或數十人，薪水所出，皆刻剝民間。

translations.literal: Assistant staff numbered ten or more, or dozens—their salaries all extracted from the people.
translations.idiomatic: Assistants numbered anywhere from a dozen to several dozen, all paid by squeezing the people.

sentences.zh: 刁生劣監，因以把持地方；

translations.literal: Scheming students and inferior supervising students thereby controlled local affairs;
translations.idiomatic: Scheming students and unworthy supervising students used the system to dominate local affairs;

sentences.zh: 狡吏貪夫，藉以希圖名利，流弊實多。

translations.literal: cunning clerks and greedy men used the opportunity to seek fame and profit—abuses were indeed many.
translations.idiomatic: cunning clerks and greedy men seized the chance for profit and advancement—the abuses were endless.

sentences.zh: 各省團練大臣，直隸桑春榮操守尚嚴，山東杜已嘖有煩言，至於江北、江南所辦鄉團，自上年至今，未聞有團練大臣收復一州一縣者，徒以騷動天下，無益有損。

translations.literal: Among provincial militia supervisors, Sang Chunrong of Zhili maintained relatively strict integrity; Du of Shandong was already much criticized; as for village militia organized in Jiangbei and Jiangnan, from last year to now not one prefecture or county had been recovered by a militia supervisor—they merely disturbed the realm, useless and harmful.
translations.idiomatic: Of the provincial supervisors, Sang Chunrong in Zhili was relatively upright, while Du in Shandong was already widely criticized. As for village militia in Jiangbei and Jiangnan, not one prefecture or county had been recovered since the previous year—they had merely stirred up the country, doing harm and no good.

sentences.zh: 今山東杜已經撤回，河南毛昶熙較有成效，其直隸、江南、江北等處團練大臣，宜一併撤回。

translations.literal: Now Du of Shandong has been recalled; Mao Changxi of Henan has been somewhat effective; the militia supervisors of Zhili, Jiangnan, Jiangbei, and other places should all be recalled together.
translations.idiomatic: Du in Shandong had already been recalled, and Mao Changxi in Henan had achieved some success; the supervisors in Zhili, Jiangnan, Jiangbei, and elsewhere should all be recalled as well.

sentences.zh: 其各省州縣距賊較遠者，停止辦團，以安民業。

translations.literal: In provincial prefectures and counties farther from rebels, militia organization should cease to settle the people's livelihoods.
translations.idiomatic: In prefectures and counties far from the fighting, militia organization should stop so people can return to their livelihoods.

sentences.zh: 其距賊較近之處，仍責地方官切實辦團，而以本省督撫總其成，庶事權不至紛歧，商民可免滋擾。」

translations.literal: In places nearer rebels, local officials should still be charged with earnest militia organization, with provincial governors overseeing completion, so authority is not divided and merchants and people spared further harassment.'
translations.idiomatic: Where rebels were nearer, local officials should still organize militia in earnest under provincial governors, so authority stays unified and merchants and common people are spared further harassment.'

sentences.zh: 旋奉諭：「直隸團練大臣桑春榮回京供職，直隸團練事宜，責成文煜辦理。

translations.literal: Soon an edict: 'Zhili Militia Supervisor Sang Chunrong returns to the capital for duty; Zhili militia affairs are entrusted to Wen Yu.
translations.idiomatic: An edict soon followed: 'Zhili Militia Supervisor Sang Chunrong is to return to the capital; Wen Yu will handle Zhili militia affairs.

sentences.zh: 江西團練大臣劉繹來京任用，江西團練事宜，責成毓科督同官紳辦理。

translations.literal: Jiangxi Militia Supervisor Liu Yi comes to the capital for appointment; Jiangxi militia affairs are entrusted to Yu Ke to supervise together with officials and gentry.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangxi Militia Supervisor Liu Yi is coming to the capital for appointment; Yu Ke will supervise Jiangxi militia together with local officials and gentry.

sentences.zh: 其二省京官如有回籍辦團者，各部院查取職名，飭令來京供職。

translations.literal: If capital officials from these two provinces on home leave are organizing militia, each ministry should take their names and order them to return to the capital for duty.
translations.idiomatic: Any capital officials from those two provinces who have gone home to organize militia are to be identified by their ministries and ordered back to the capital.

sentences.zh: 江北團練大臣晏端書，江西團練大臣龐鍾璐，其辦理團練，是否仍須該員經理，抑或即可裁撤，令曾國籓、薛煥速議以聞。

translations.literal: Jiangbei Militia Supervisor Yan Duanshu and Jiangxi Militia Supervisor Pang Zhonglu—whether militia affairs still require these men to manage them or can immediately be abolished—Zeng Guofan and Xue Huan are ordered quickly to deliberate and report.
translations.idiomatic: As for Jiangbei supervisor Yan Duanshu and Jiangxi supervisor Pang Zhonglu, Zeng Guofan and Xue Huan are to decide quickly whether their posts are still needed or can be abolished at once.

sentences.zh: 王履謙幫辦浙江團練，兼辦浙東捐務，今浙江軍務方殷，自難遽撤。

translations.literal: Wang Luqian assisting Zhejiang militia and concurrently handling eastern Zhejiang donation affairs—now Zhejiang military affairs are pressing and he can hardly be abruptly removed.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Luqian, who assists Zhejiang militia and handles eastern Zhejiang donations, cannot easily be removed while Zhejiang's military situation remains urgent.

sentences.zh: 令王有齡會同王履謙切實籌辦，以固疆圉。

translations.literal: Wang Youling was ordered to consult with Wang Luqian and earnestly organize affairs to strengthen the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Youling was ordered to work with Wang Luqian and organize matters in earnest to secure the frontier.

sentences.zh: 毛昶熙在河南歸德著有成效，應否仍令毛昶熙督辦團練，及有無把握之處，令嚴樹森速議以聞。」

translations.literal: Mao Changxi achieved notable results in Guide, Henan—whether he should still supervise militia and where there is or is not confidence—Yan Shusen is ordered quickly to deliberate and report.'
translations.idiomatic: Mao Changxi had achieved notable results in Guide, Henan; Yan Shusen is to decide quickly whether he should continue supervising militia and where confidence is lacking.'

sentences.zh: 旋兩江總督曾國籓覆陳：「團練之設，只能防小支千餘之游匪，不能剿大股數萬之悍賊。

translations.literal: Soon Governor-General Zeng Guofan replied: 'Militia organization can only defend against small bands of a thousand or so roving bandits; it cannot suppress large forces of tens of thousands of fierce rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Zeng Guofan soon replied: 'Militia can hold off roving bands of a thousand or so, but they cannot suppress rebel armies tens of thousands strong.

sentences.zh: 其練丁口糧，若太多，則與募勇之價相等，不必僅以團名；

translations.literal: If militiamen's rations are too high, they equal the price of recruited braves and need not be called militia only;
translations.idiomatic: If militiamen's rations are too high, they cost as much as recruited braves and the 'militia' label means little;

sentences.zh: 若太少，則與官勇之餉迥殊，不能得其死力。

translations.literal: if too low, they differ greatly from official braves' pay and their utmost loyalty cannot be obtained.
translations.idiomatic: if too low, they fall far below official braves' pay and will not fight to the death.

sentences.zh: 其團防經費，若取諸丁、漕、釐、捐四者之中，則有礙督撫籌款之途；

translations.literal: If militia defense funds are taken from land tax, grain transport, transit levies, and donations, they obstruct governors' fundraising;
translations.idiomatic: If militia funds come from land tax, grain transport, transit levies, or donations, they interfere with the governors' own revenue;

sentences.zh: 若設法四者之外，則更無措手之處。

translations.literal: if sought beyond these four, there is no other means at hand.
translations.idiomatic: and if you look beyond those four sources, there is nowhere else to turn.

sentences.zh: 事權既無專屬，剛柔實覺兩難。

translations.literal: With no exclusive authority, firmness and flexibility both feel impossible.
translations.idiomatic: With no clear authority, it is impossible to strike the right balance between firmness and flexibility.

sentences.zh: 晏端書在江北不設餉局，但勸各邑築圩自保，龐鍾璐在江南激勸鄉民，俾知同仇敵愾之義，辦理極有斟酌。

translations.literal: Yan Duanshu in Jiangbei set up no pay bureau but urged each county to build dikes for self-defense; Pang Zhonglu in Jiangnan stirred village people to understand shared enmity—both handled matters with great discretion.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Duanshu in Jiangbei created no pay bureau but urged counties to build dikes for self-defense; Pang Zhonglu in Jiangnan roused villagers to shared resolve—both handled matters with notable restraint.

sentences.zh: 今之賊勢，決非鄉團所能奏功。

translations.literal: Today's rebel strength absolutely cannot be overcome by village militia.
translations.idiomatic: Today's rebels are far too strong for village militia to defeat.

sentences.zh: 應俟賊氛稍衰，大功將成，然後辦團練以善其後。

translations.literal: Militia training should wait until rebel strength declines somewhat and great success is near, then organize militia to finish matters properly.
translations.idiomatic: Militia should wait until rebel strength fades and final victory is near, then be organized properly to secure the aftermath.

sentences.zh: 晏端書、龐鍾璐二員，清操雅望，內任最宜。

translations.literal: Yan Duanshu and Pang Zhonglu—both men of pure conduct and lofty reputation—are most suited for capital appointments.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Duanshu and Pang Zhonglu, both men of integrity and reputation, are best suited for posts in the capital.

sentences.zh: 應請裁去團練差使，回京供職。」

translations.literal: Their militia commissions should be abolished and they should return to the capital for duty.'
translations.idiomatic: Their militia commissions should be abolished and they should return to the capital.'

sentences.zh: 疏入，允之。

translations.literal: Memorial submitted, approved.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was approved.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，諭：「鄉團之設，原以使民自衛身家，藉可保全地方，以輔官兵。

translations.literal: First year of Tongzhi, edict: 'Village militia were originally established so people could defend their own lives and property, thereby preserving the locality and assisting regular troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tongzhi an edict declared: 'Village militia were meant to let people defend their own lives and property, preserve their districts, and assist regular troops.

sentences.zh: 前因各路辦理團練大臣隨帶多員，任意騷擾，有害無利，是以陸續裁撤，仍責令地方官切實經理。

translations.literal: Previously because militia supervisors along various routes brought many staff who harassed at will, harmful without benefit, they were abolished one after another and local officials were again charged with earnest management.
translations.idiomatic: Because militia supervisors along various routes had brought large staffs who harassed the people at will, those posts were abolished one by one and local officials were again charged with managing militia in earnest.

sentences.zh: 乃邇來統兵大員，守土牧令，或恐其分餉而輕為裁撤，或疑其無益而視為具文，於是民心不固，盜賊橫行，所過州縣村莊，動遭劫掠，是又地方官不能因地制宜舉行團練之所致，因噎廢食，貽誤殊多。

translations.literal: Yet recently commanding generals and territorial magistrates, either fearing division of pay and lightly abolishing militia, or doubting their use and treating them as empty form—popular resolve was not firm, bandits ran rampant, and prefectures, counties, and villages passed through were constantly plundered—this again stemmed from local officials unable to organize militia according to local conditions; rejecting food because of choking caused much loss.
translations.idiomatic: Yet recently commanding generals and local magistrates, either fearing militia would drain military funds and abolishing them too readily, or treating them as empty paperwork, left popular resolve weak and bandits unchecked—prefectures, counties, and villages were plundered everywhere. This again came from local officials failing to organize militia according to local conditions; throwing out the remedy because of past abuse caused grave harm.

sentences.zh: 嗣後各省團練，仍由督撫臣通飭各州縣，選公正紳士，實力興辦。

translations.literal: Hereafter provincial militia shall still be ordered by governors through all prefectures and counties, selecting upright gentry and earnestly organizing.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth governors are again to order every prefecture and county to select upright gentry and organize militia in earnest.

sentences.zh: 務使官不掣肘，民悉同心，城市鄉村，聲勢聯絡。

translations.literal: Officials must not obstruct, people must all be of one mind, cities and villages linked in defensive reach.
translations.idiomatic: Officials must not obstruct them, the people must stand together, and cities and villages must be linked in mutual defense.

sentences.zh: 其有認真辦理保全地方者，將其實在勞績，聲明保獎。」

translations.literal: Those who earnestly organize and preserve the locality shall have their actual achievements declared for reward.'
translations.idiomatic: Those who truly organize militia and preserve their districts shall have their achievements reported for reward.'

sentences.zh: 二年，以都察院代遞山東貢生硃德秀條陳團練事宜，語多可采，命硃德秀回籍，隨同英桂、趙德轍辦理團練，並命英桂督飭官紳，就地方情形，認真辦團，毋得有名無實。

translations.literal: Second year, the Censorate transmitted Shandong tribute student Zhu Dexiu's memorial on militia affairs—much of it adoptable; Zhu Dexiu was ordered to return home and assist Ying Gui and Zhao Dezhe in organizing militia; Ying Gui was ordered to supervise officials and gentry according to local conditions to organize earnestly without being nominal.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year the Censorate forwarded a memorial on militia from Shandong tribute student Zhu Dexiu, much of it worth adopting. Zhu was ordered home to assist Ying Gui and Zhao Dezhe in organizing militia, and Ying Gui was told to supervise officials and gentry according to local conditions—no empty show.

sentences.zh: 是年，統兵大臣僧格林沁疏言：「各省練團築寨，本以助守望而禦寇盜，為權宜補救之法。

translations.literal: That year, commanding general Sengge Rinchen memorialized: 'Provincial militia building stockades were originally to assist watch duties and repel bandits—a temporary remedial method.
translations.idiomatic: That year commanding general Sengge Rinchen memorialized: 'Provincial militia stockades were meant to help with watch duty and repel bandits—a temporary expedient.

sentences.zh: 乃各團每以有寨可據，輒藐視官長，擅理詞訟，或聚眾抗糧，或挾仇械鬥，甚至謀為不軌，踞城戕官，如山東之劉德培，河南之李瞻，先後倡亂，而安徽之苗沛霖，尤為梟桀反覆，勞師糜餉，始得次第翦除。

translations.literal: Yet each militia band, having stockades to rely on, often despised official superiors, adjudicated lawsuits on their own, gathered crowds to resist grain taxes, fought feuds with weapons, even plotted treason and seized cities killing officials—such as Liu Depei in Shandong, Li Zhan in Henan, who stirred rebellion one after another; and Miao Peilin of Anhui was especially a fierce, treacherous figure—only after exhausting troops and funds was he gradually eliminated.
translations.idiomatic: Yet once militia had stockades to fall back on, they often defied officials, judged cases on their own, resisted grain taxes in armed crowds, fought private feuds, and even plotted rebellion—seizing cities and killing officials, as with Liu Depei in Shandong and Li Zhan in Henan. Miao Peilin in Anhui was especially fierce and treacherous; only after great expense in troops and funds was he finally cut down.

sentences.zh: 辦團之舉，始則合一鄉為一團，繼則聯眾團為一練，地廣人多，良莠不齊，不肖團長有跋扈情形，承辦團練紳士又不能杜漸防微，隨時舉發，致有尾大不掉之勢。

translations.literal: Militia organization began with one village as one company, then linked many companies into one training unit; with broad territory and many people, good and bad mixed—unworthy militia chiefs grew overbearing, and gentry organizing militia could not check evils early and report in time, leading to a situation where the tail wags the dog.
translations.idiomatic: Militia began as one village, one company, then linked many companies into larger units. With broad territory and mixed quality, bad militia chiefs grew overbearing, and organizing gentry failed to check abuses in time, until the force became unmanageable.

sentences.zh: 況捻匪屢經竄擾之區，亦未見各團堵御得力。

translations.literal: Moreover, in areas repeatedly raided by Nian bandits, no militia company was seen to block effectively.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, in areas repeatedly hit by Nian bandits, no militia company proved effective at blocking them.

sentences.zh: 其河南團練，均由侍郎毛昶熙管理。

translations.literal: Henan militia were all managed by Vice Minister Mao Changxi.
translations.idiomatic: All Henan militia were managed by Vice Minister Mao Changxi.

sentences.zh: 毛昶熙於通省地方，勢難周曆兼顧，而各練既有專管大員，地方官轉至呼應不靈。

translations.literal: Mao Changxi could hardly tour the entire province; yet with each training unit having dedicated supervisors, local officials became less responsive.
translations.idiomatic: Mao Changxi could hardly cover the whole province, yet with each training unit under its own supervisor, local officials became harder to coordinate.

sentences.zh: 今賊氛漸平，請命毛昶熙回京供職，所有團練，視直隸、山東之例，歸地方官經理，以一事權。

translations.literal: Now rebel strength is gradually pacified—Mao Changxi is requested to return to the capital; all militia, following the Zhili and Shandong precedent, should revert to local official management to unify authority.
translations.idiomatic: Now that rebel strength is fading, Mao Changxi should return to the capital; all militia should follow the Zhili and Shandong precedent and revert to local official management.

sentences.zh: 並請飭河南巡撫嚴查各團，如有增置軍械等事，均責令稟請地方官允准置備。

translations.literal: Also order the Henan governor strictly to inspect each company; if arms are added, all must report to local officials for approval before acquisition.
translations.idiomatic: The Henan governor should also inspect every company strictly; any addition of arms must be approved by local officials in advance.

sentences.zh: 如不肖團長借修圍制械，種種斂錢，以致苦累鄉民，即從嚴懲辦，庶幾權歸於上，免滋流弊。」

translations.literal: If unworthy militia chiefs use fort repairs and armament manufacture as pretexts to levy money in every way, burdening village people, punish severely—then authority may rest with superiors and abuses avoided.'
translations.idiomatic: If bad militia chiefs use fort repairs or armaments as pretexts to levy money and burden villagers, they should be punished severely so authority stays with the government and abuses are checked.'

sentences.zh: 御史裘德俊疏言：「團練之舉，本屬有治人無治法。

translations.literal: Censor Qiu Dejun memorialized: 'Militia training is fundamentally a matter of having the right people to govern, not methods that govern themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Qiu Dejun argued: 'Militia training depends on the right people to run it, not on rules alone.

sentences.zh: 今直隸善後章程，有抽撥鄉團訓練之議。

translations.literal: Now Zhili's postwar regulations include a proposal to draft village militia for training.
translations.idiomatic: Zhili's postwar regulations now propose drafting village militia for training.

sentences.zh: 但抽撥鄉兵，必得賢明牧令，駕馭有方，乃能權不下移，民無擾累。

translations.literal: But drafting village militia requires wise magistrates who control them well—only then can authority not shift downward and people not suffer harassment.
translations.idiomatic: But drafting militiamen requires wise magistrates who control them well; only then can authority stay centralized and the people avoid harassment.

sentences.zh: 若遇不肖州縣，借端苛斂，抽丁派費，吏胥因緣為奸，上下咸思中飽，小民已不聊生；

translations.literal: If corrupt prefectures and counties use pretexts for harsh levies, conscripting men and imposing fees, clerks seizing opportunities for fraud, superiors and subordinates all seeking to fill their pockets—the common people already cannot survive;
translations.idiomatic: Under corrupt officials, conscription becomes harsh levies, clerks seize chances to cheat, and everyone from top to bottom seeks a cut—the common people can barely survive;

sentences.zh: 加以每縣聚眾數百人，游手無著，以強凌弱，甚或恃眾把持，一有亂萌，尤易響應，不可不遠慮及之。」

translations.literal: add that each county gathers hundreds of idle men with no fixed occupation, strong bullying weak, some even relying on numbers to dominate—once unrest begins they respond easily; this cannot but be considered from afar.'
translations.idiomatic: and when each county gathers hundreds of idle men, the strong bully the weak, some dominate by sheer numbers—once trouble starts they join in readily. This danger cannot be ignored.'

sentences.zh: 旋奉諭：「山東鄉團已由官為經理，所有河南省團練事宜，亦統歸官辦，以一事權。

translations.literal: Soon edict: 'Shandong village militia are already managed by officials; all Henan militia affairs are also unified under official management to consolidate authority.
translations.idiomatic: An edict soon followed: 'Shandong village militia are already under official management; Henan militia will also be handled entirely by officials to unify authority.

sentences.zh: 其直隸抽練團丁，督臣劉長佑權其利害，是否可行，如有窒礙之處，即據實以聞。」

translations.literal: As for Zhili's drafting of militiamen for training, Governor Liu Changyou should weigh pros and cons whether feasible; if obstructed, report truthfully.'
translations.idiomatic: As for Zhili's plan to draft militiamen for training, Governor Liu Changyou should weigh the pros and cons and report any obstacles frankly.'

sentences.zh: 六年，李雲麟招募奇古民勇駐八里岡，與科布多、塔爾巴哈台蒙兵為犄角。

translations.literal: Sixth year, Li Yunlin recruited Qigu civilian braves garrisoned at Balingang, supporting Mongol troops of Kobdo and Tarbagatai in mutual coordination.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year Li Yunlin recruited Qigu civilian braves for Balingang, coordinating with Mongol troops at Kobdo and Tarbagatai.

sentences.zh: 七年，諭各疆臣：「捻寇蕩平，勇丁亦各還鄉里，誠恐江南、安徽、河南、山東從前被兵處所，不免伏莽潛匿，乘隙為害。

translations.literal: Seventh year, edict to frontier governors: 'Nian bandits are pacified and braves have returned to their villages; it is feared that in Jiangnan, Anhui, Henan, and Shandong areas previously ravaged by war, hidden ruffians may lurk and seize opportunities to harm.
