translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year frontier governors were told: 'The Nian rebels are suppressed and braves have gone home, but in war-ravaged Jiangnan, Anhui, Henan, and Shandong, hidden ruffians may still lurk and strike when they can.

sentences.zh: 江、皖等省督撫，於徐、海、潁、亳、歸、汝、曹、沂等處，飭各地方官勸諭民間照舊修理圩寨，整頓鄉團，互相保衛。

translations.literal: Governors of Jiangsu and Anhui in Xuzhou, Haizhou, Yingzhou, Bozhou, Gui prefecture, Ruzhou, Caozhou, Yizhou, and other places shall order local officials to urge people to repair dikes and stockades as before, reorganize village militia, and protect one another.
translations.idiomatic: Governors of Jiangsu and Anhui were to order local officials in Xuzhou, Haizhou, Yingzhou, Bozhou, Gui, Ruzhou, Caozhou, Yizhou, and other districts to repair dikes and stockades, reorganize village militia, and protect one another as before.

sentences.zh: 此外各處民團，亦應一律整飭，慎選牧令，安良除暴，以靖地方。」

translations.literal: People's militia elsewhere should also uniformly be reorganized, magistrates chosen carefully, good people secured and violence suppressed to quiet the locality.'
translations.idiomatic: People's militia elsewhere should also be reorganized, capable magistrates chosen, the law-abiding protected and the violent suppressed, to quiet every district.'

sentences.zh: 十二年，因四川峨邊廳蠻族投誠，擇充千百戶等職，編製夷兵，建修碉堡。

translations.literal: Twelfth year, because Yi tribes in Ebian Prefecture, Sichuan submitted allegiance, selected chiefs for thousand-household and hundred-household posts, organized Yi troops, and built blockhouses.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, after Yi tribes in Ebian Prefecture, Sichuan submitted, chiefs were appointed as thousand- and hundred-household officers, Yi troops were organized, and blockhouses built.

sentences.zh: 光緒六年，兩廣總督張之洞募沙民千人助守虎門，楊玉科增募千人及惠清營五百人，鄭紹忠募安勇二千人，所募鄉兵，以防勇規制編之。

translations.literal: Sixth year of Guangxu, Governor-General Zhang Zhidong of the Two Guangs recruited one thousand sand-dwellers to help garrison Humen; Yang Yuke added one thousand and five hundred for the Huiqing Camp; Zheng Shaozhong recruited two thousand An braves—all recruited local militia organized under defensive brave regulations.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Guangxu, Governor-General Zhang Zhidong recruited one thousand sand-dwellers for Humen; Yang Yuke added one thousand men and five hundred for the Huiqing Camp; Zheng Shaozhong raised two thousand An braves—all organized as local militia under defensive brave regulations.

sentences.zh: 是年，命黑龍江將軍於增練馬隊外，秋冬之季，招集打牲人等，加以訓練。

translations.literal: That year, the Heilongjiang general was ordered besides expanding cavalry training, in autumn and winter to gather tribute hunters and train them.
translations.idiomatic: That year the Heilongjiang general was ordered, besides expanding cavalry training, to gather tribute hunters each autumn and winter for drill.

sentences.zh: 八年，兩江總督左宗棠以江蘇沿江海州縣捕魚為業者甚多，於內江外海風濤沙線無不熟諳，而崇明尤為各海口漁戶爭趨之所。

translations.literal: Eighth year, Governor-General Zuo Zongtang noted many fishermen in Jiangsu coastal prefectures and counties familiar with inner river and outer sea winds, waves, and sandbars—Chongming especially the gathering place all fishing households at various ports strive toward.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year Governor-General Zuo Zongtang noted that many fishermen in Jiangsu's coastal prefectures and counties knew inner rivers and outer seas, winds, waves, and sandbars intimately—Chongming above all was where fishing households from every port converged.

sentences.zh: 其中有技勇而悉洋務者，所在不乏。

translations.literal: Among them many possessed martial skill and understood foreign affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Many among them were skilled fighters who understood foreign affairs.

sentences.zh: 外洋船駛入內江者，每用漁戶為導。

translations.literal: When foreign ships entered inner rivers, fishermen were often used as guides.
translations.idiomatic: Foreign ships entering inner rivers often relied on fishermen as pilots.

sentences.zh: 江蘇自川沙迄贛榆二十二州縣，濱臨江海，漁戶約數萬人。

translations.literal: From Chuansha to Ganyu across twenty-two prefectures and counties in Jiangsu bordering rivers and sea, fishing households numbered about tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: From Chuansha to Ganyu, twenty-two Jiangsu prefectures and counties along the rivers and coast held tens of thousands of fishing households.

sentences.zh: 乃令蘇松太道員為沿海漁團督辦，於漁戶每百人中，選壯健三十人，練漁團五千名，設總局於吳淞口，設分局於濱海各縣，每月操練二次，習水勇技藝，用以捕盜緝私，兼備水師之選。

translations.literal: The Suzhou-Songjiang-Taiwan Circuit Intendant was appointed supervisor of coastal fishing militia; from every hundred fishing households, thirty sturdy men were selected—five thousand fishing militia trained; a headquarters at Wusong and branch offices in coastal counties; drilled twice monthly in naval martial skills for catching bandits, suppressing smuggling, and selecting naval troops.
translations.idiomatic: The Suzhou-Songjiang-Taiwan circuit intendant was appointed to supervise coastal fishing militia. From every hundred fishing households thirty sturdy men were chosen—five thousand fishing militia in all—with a headquarters at Wusong and branch offices in coastal counties. They drilled twice monthly in naval skills to catch bandits, suppress smuggling, and supply recruits for the navy.

sentences.zh: 十一年，雲貴總督岑毓英釐定雲南通省營制，裸黑勇丁，編為六營，西南土防，編為二十五營。

translations.literal: Eleventh year, Yunnan-Guizhou Governor-General Cen Yuying fixed Yunnan provincial garrison organization—Luohei brave militiamen organized into six battalions, southwestern native defense into twenty-five battalions.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year Governor-General Cen Yuying of Yunnan-Guizhou fixed Yunnan's garrison organization: Luohei brave militiamen were formed into six battalions and southwestern frontier defense into twenty-five battalions.

sentences.zh: 又因雲南沿邊，由西而東南，皆野人山寨，布列於九隘之外，乃調兵二千人，與原有防軍及鄉團土司，協力警備。

translations.literal: Because Yunnan's frontier from west to southeast was all wild people's mountain stockades arrayed beyond the nine passes, two thousand troops were mobilized to cooperate with original garrison troops, village militia, and native chieftains in alert defense.
translations.idiomatic: Because Yunnan's frontier from west to southeast was lined with wild people's stockades beyond the nine passes, two thousand troops were mobilized to work with existing garrisons, village militia, and native chieftains in frontier defense.

sentences.zh: 督辦廣東軍務大臣彭玉麟以欽州、廉州地廣兵單，招募鄉團協守。

translations.literal: Peng Yulin, supervising Guangdong military affairs, because Qinzhou and Lianzhou had broad territory and sparse troops, recruited village militia to assist in garrison.
translations.idiomatic: Peng Yulin, supervising Guangdong military affairs, recruited village militia to help garrison Qinzhou and Lianzhou, where territory was broad and troops were few.

sentences.zh: 是年，吉林將軍增練防軍，佐以烏拉牲丁，凡萬五千人。

translations.literal: That year, the Jilin general expanded defensive garrison training, assisted by Wula tribute hunters, totaling fifteen thousand men.
translations.idiomatic: That year the Jilin general expanded defensive garrisons, supported by Wula tribute hunters, for a total of fifteen thousand men.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，都察院代陳湖南舉人何鎮圭條陳團練事宜，命兵部議奏。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, the Censorate transmitted Hunan juren He Zhengui's memorial setting forth militia affairs; the Ministry of War was ordered to deliberate and report.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year the Censorate forwarded a militia memorial from Hunan juren He Zhengui and ordered the Ministry of War to deliberate and report.

sentences.zh: 又諭：「侍郎張廕桓疏請實行團練，同時臣工屢有仿西法練民兵之請。

translations.literal: Another edict stated: 'Vice Minister Zhang Yinhuan memorialized requesting the earnest implementation of militia training; at the same time officials have repeatedly requested training people's militia according to Western methods.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict stated: 'Vice Minister Zhang Yinhuan memorialized for earnest militia training, while other officials had repeatedly called for people's militia trained on Western models.

sentences.zh: 若各省實行團練，即以鄉團為民兵，用更番替換之法，較諸遽練民兵為有把握。

translations.literal: If each province earnestly implements militia training, taking village militia as people's militia and using a method of rotating replacements, this is more reliable than hastily training people's militia.
translations.idiomatic: If provinces organize militia in earnest, using village companies as people's militia on a rotating basis, that approach is surer than rushing to train a new militia from scratch.

sentences.zh: 廣西會匪滋事，尤宜速辦，以收捍禦之功。

translations.literal: The Guangxi secret-society rebels are causing trouble and this should especially be organized quickly to achieve defensive success.
translations.idiomatic: With secret-society unrest in Guangxi, militia should be organized there especially quickly to secure the frontier.

sentences.zh: 各省督撫一律切實籌辦。

translations.literal: Provincial governors in every province are uniformly to organize this earnestly.
translations.idiomatic: Every provincial governor is to organize militia in earnest.

sentences.zh: 各省於三月內，廣東、廣西於一月內，將辦理情形，具疏以聞。」

translations.literal: Each province within three months, and Guangdong and Guangxi within one month, shall report the conditions of implementation by memorial.'
translations.idiomatic: All provinces are to report progress within three months; Guangdong and Guangxi within one month.'

sentences.zh: 三十年，廣西巡撫柯逢時令廣西各州縣增募鄉勇八千人，給以毛瑟後膛槍，並令民間多築碉堡，共御外侮。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year, Guangxi Governor Ke Fengshi ordered each prefecture and county in Guangxi to expand recruitment of local braves by eight thousand men, supply them with Mauser breech-loading rifles, and urge the people to build many blockhouses to resist foreign aggression together.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year Guangxi Governor Ke Fengshi ordered every prefecture and county to raise eight thousand additional local braves, arm them with Mauser rifles, and urge the people to build more blockhouses against foreign aggression.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，兩廣總督李經羲增練防營，並募土著鄉兵，備廣西邊境。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year, Governor-General Li Jingyi of the Two Guangs expanded defensive battalion training and recruited native local militia to guard the Guangxi frontier.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year Governor-General Li Jingyi of the Two Guangs expanded defensive battalions and recruited native local militia for the Guangxi border.

sentences.zh: 新疆巡撫潘效蘇以新疆兵費太重，改募土著，仿勇營訓練，次第遣散客軍。

translations.literal: Xinjiang Governor Pan Xiaosu, because Xinjiang military expenses were too heavy, shifted to recruiting natives, training them on the model of brave battalions, and disbanding guest troops in sequence.
translations.idiomatic: Xinjiang Governor Pan Xiaosu, finding military costs too heavy, shifted to recruiting natives, training them like brave battalions, and gradually disbanding outside troops.

sentences.zh: 三十四年，雲南防軍裁併，於騰越、臨安兩路創設團練，藉資捍衛。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year, Yunnan defensive troops were reduced and consolidated; militia training was newly established on the Tengyue and Lin'an routes to assist in defense.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fourth year Yunnan garrisons were cut and merged, and new militia were organized on the Tengyue and Lin'an routes for frontier defense.

sentences.zh: 宣統元年，各省改防營為巡防隊。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xuantong, each province changed defensive battalions into patrol defense corps.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xuantong every province converted defensive battalions into patrol defense corps.

sentences.zh: 雲貴總督沈秉堃以雲南防軍內有各屬之保衛團，系昔日之鄉團，名為營隊，實即鄉兵，未能遽改為巡防隊，乃仍其舊。

translations.literal: Yunnan-Guizhou Governor-General Shen Bingkun noted that within Yunnan's defensive troops were guard companies of various subordinate districts—formerly village militia, called battalion companies but in reality local militia—which could not immediately be changed into patrol defense corps, and so the old arrangement was retained.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Shen Bingkun of Yunnan-Guizhou noted that Yunnan's garrisons included guard companies in various districts—formerly village militia, called battalion units but really local militia—that could not be converted at once to patrol corps, so the old arrangement remained.

sentences.zh: 此鄉兵舉廢之概略也。

translations.literal: This is a general outline of the establishment and abolition of local militia.
translations.idiomatic: Such, in broad outline, is the story of how local militia were raised and abolished.
